sections.text:
Senior Accounts Executive with 3.5 years of experience in India Finance Operations, Accounts Payable, statutory compliances, and payroll management. Proven ability to independently manage month-end close, high-volume 
WORK EXPERIENCE
Vigocare Private Limited | Hyderabad
Senior Accounts Executive – Finance Operations & Statutory Compliance
Dec 2023 - Present
Independently managing end-to-end Accounts Payable operations, including vendor invoice verification, • postings, ageing control, and payments through NEFT/RTGS. • Handling monthly transaction volumes of ₹1–2 Cr, ensuring accuracy, internal controls, and timely closure. • Performing vendor reconciliations and preparing Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) to ensure accuracy • of cash and bank balances. • Owning month-end and year-end close management, including journal entries, accruals, ledger scrutiny, and • balance confirmations. • Preparing MIS, cash flow statements, and management reports for review and decision-making. • Limited knowledge-level exposure to revenue tracking and overseas billing for cash flow monitoring and • MIS purposes. • Owning preparation, reconciliation, and coordination with consultants for GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) and PF, • PT, and ESIC compliances, with final statutory filings handled through consultants. • Managing end-to-end TDS compliance, including calculations, challans, and returns. • Independently managing end-to-end payroll for 120 employees, including salary processing and statutory • deductions. • Leading audit coordination by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and statutory data for internal and • external audits. • Acting as SPOC for finance operations and driving process improvement initiatives. Feb 2023 - Dec 2023
Independently managing end-to-end Accounts Payable operations, including vendor invoice verification, • postings, ageing control, and payments through NEFT/RTGS. • Handling monthly transaction volumes of ₹1–2 Cr, ensuring accuracy, internal controls, and timely closure. • Performing vendor reconciliations and preparing Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) to ensure accuracy • of cash and bank balances. • Owning month-end and year-end close management, including journal entries, accruals, ledger scrutiny, and • balance confirmations. • Preparing MIS, cash flow statements, and management reports for review and decision-making. • Limited knowledge-level exposure to revenue tracking and overseas billing for cash flow monitoring and • MIS purposes. • Owning preparation, reconciliation, and coordination with consultants for GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) and PF, • PT, and ESIC compliances, with final statutory filings handled through consultants. • Managing end-to-end TDS compliance, including calculations, challans, and returns. • Independently managing end-to-end payroll for 120 employees, including salary processing and statutory • deductions. • Leading audit coordination by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and statutory data for internal and • external audits. • Acting as SPOC for finance operations and driving process improvement initiatives. Feb 2023 - Dec 2023
Godavari Cuts | Hyderabad
Handled Accounts Payable activities, including invoice verification, vendor payment scheduling, and • reconciliation of outstanding balances. • Prepared and maintained daily and monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS). • Supported month-end activities through basic reconciliations and ledger checks. • Assisted in GST data preparation and return filings, ensuring statutory compliance. • Supported TDS calculations, documentation, and compliance requirements. • Maintained accurate accounting records and supported statutory audits. • Coordinated with vendors and internal departments to resolve discrepancies and ensure smooth financial
